|showheader = n }} '''Green Canes''' are a decorative piece of [[furniture]] that can be purchased from the Decoration Boat at the [[Night Market]] for {{Price|200}}. It can be won from the Crane Game inside the [[Movie Theater]], during {{season|winter}}. They may be placed anywhere in Stardew Valley, indoors or out. ==History== {{History|1.3.27|Introduced.}} {{History|1.4|Can now be obtained from Crane Game in the Movie Theater.
